notes: The booklet has three models (sea plane, sailboat/catamaran, hovercraft-style boat) that reuse the same 53 pieces. Since each piece is one node, only the main model (Sea Plane, pages 2-13) is built as connections; the alternate models are not separately instantiated.

The previous 5 groups were the main build plus four pieces unused by the sea plane (2x white Brick 1x2 b50/b51, 2x orange Tile 1x3 b52/b53), which belong to the alternate models. They are now tied to the main build only with `contact` (resting, not fastened) edges as spare pieces; no joined edges are claimed for them.
Page images are low resolution: exact stud-level positions and which piece sits on which are best-effort. Ports are null where uncertain.
The fuselage base is read as two 1x4 plates (3710) side by side, bridged by the inverted slope; the three 1x6 plates (3666) are used in the floats (one per float plus a cross plate).
Orange 2x2 plate (b36) and orange 1x2 plate (b37) were placed on the wing centre/tail area as the best match to pages 7-9.
Floats attach to the fuselage by the bar-holder-with-clip pieces clipping onto two of the silver round plates; the handle plate b49 is assumed to sit on the float cross plate.
